messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [SEV-2] Latency SLO breach for tenant=FinApps on /v1/chat/stream — p99 ~ 12.1s, p95 ~ 1.1s. Streaming stalls observed (chunk gaps >2s). Pager: <https://pager/redwood/inc/1758004567|incident/1758004567>

alex: oncall grabbing. seeing identical spike across eu-west-1 for FinApps only. other tenants normal. starting triage.

mira: looking at metrics now — GPU utilization on serving nodes is normal (~40%), but proxy (nginx/gateway) CPU and socket queues are spiking. tcp_retransmits up on node-7. kube-proxy has a restart at 1758003200.

samir: interesting — could be proxy backpressure + long-running model decodes. any correlation with recent model change or customer prompt patterns?

jess: customer-support reports FinApps saw many simultaneous user sessions after a batch job kicked off at 09:02 UTC. they sent a snippet of prompts (sanitized).

alex: paste of the sanitized prompt sample from FinApps (truncated):
```
=== BEGIN PROMPT ===
Analyze the following long transaction history and generate step-by-step recon summary:
[VERY LARGE PASTE, repeated account lines, many duplicate tokens and numbered bullets repeating similar phrases]
...repeated sections cause length ~45k chars
=== END PROMPT ===
```

mira: that pattern would create big KV cache churn and heavy per-request generation time. plus if streaming stalls and proxy queues line up, you get tail latencies. check model tokenization spikes.

samir: quickly checking logs for streaming stalls: found repeated pattern in runtime logs: `streamer: stall_detected last_chunk_ms=7205 tenant=FinApps req_id=abc123` and lots of `kvcache: miss_rate=0.83` around the same window.

alex: mitigation plan (temporary): 1) Route FinApps traffic to a warmed dedicated pool (dedicated-2) to bypass shared gateway contention. 2) Apply per-tenant concurrency cap = 4. 3) Enable fallback to smaller model `redwood-small-v1` for requests > 16k input tokens. 4) Increase stream chunk timeout to 10s.

jess: running runbook step: override routing now. executing: 
```
# route override
curl -X POST "https://console.api.redwood/v1/routes/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"FinApps","route":"dedicated-2"}'
# set concurrency cap
curl -X POST "https://console.api.redwood/v1/tenants/FinApps/config" -d '{"max_concurrency":4}'
```

deploy-bot: Route override applied by jess at 1758005200. Canaries 2/2 healthy.

alex: applied streaming timeout change (set to 10s) and model-fallback rule for >16k tokens.

mira: verifying infra: kube-proxy restart was unrelated (scheduled pod recycle), but nginx workers showed high accept queue and many keepalive TIME_WAIT. I pushed a short-term connection pool increase on gateway nodes to reduce drops.

samir: started a targeted request sample replay (sanitized) against dedicated-2. initial results: median latency back to ~150ms, p95 ~ 680ms, p99 ~ 1.4s for the heavy prompts. Streaming stalls not reproduced on dedicated pool. kvcache miss_rate dropped to 0.23.

alex: customer-impact summary: FinApps saw ~15% of requests hit >5s during spike window, mostly long-chain prompts and bulk sessions. No data loss, responses eventually delivered. Impacted endpoints: /v1/chat/stream (primary), /v1/chat/generate (some).

jess: notified FinApps CS and offered to switch them to dedicated-2 until we complete root-cause. they accepted.

mira: next immediate engineering checks: 1) confirm gateway keepalive tuning and connection backlog fixes hold under load. 2) examine per-tenant socket queue metrics and rate limiter triggers. 3) correlate runtime GC/pinning with token growth.

samir: engineering follow-ups: 1) add a protective short-circuit that rejects (429) requests with >40k input tokens with a clear error to customers. 2) improve KV cache LRU to better handle repetitive tokens. 3) add tenant-level heuristic that temporarily reduces batch size for long prompts to avoid long-running decode stalls.

alex: handoff: I'm paged out in 20m. mira will own active monitoring for the next 2 hours, samir will own the model/kvcache investigation, jess will coordinate customer comms and ensure tenant stays on dedicated-2.

jess: timeline: routing override at 1758005200, concurrency cap at 1758005260, stream timeout at 1758005340. visible improvement within 10-12 minutes.

mira: monitoring notes: p99 dropped from 12.1s -> 780ms by 1758005860. no further stall alerts after 1758005900.

samir: collecting logs for post-incident analysis. saving request ids and representative prompts for RFC (will sanitize).

alex: incident state = MITIGATED (temporary mitigations in place). creating follow-up ticket for RFC and long-term fixes.

incident-bot: Incident 1758004567 marked MITIGATED by alex. Follow-up: RFC-1421 (kvcache and tenant protection heuristics) assigned to samir, due 2026-04-05.

jess: action items (short):
- samir: RFC + data (request samples, kvcache heatmaps) — due 2026-04-05
- mira: Gateway tune verification under load + alert refinement (thresholds for socket queue) — due 2026-03-20
- alex: runbook update to include model-fallback triggers and token-size 429 guard — due 2026-03-18
- jess: customer postmortem and notify FinApps with timeline and mitigations — due 2026-03-16

alex: leaving handoff here, paging cleared. ping if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
